data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 (frozen lease drift field) and SRC_002 (typed exception mutation) are compatible with each other under a single minimal fixture that freezes a single lease with a drifted endpoint and asserts a typed LEASE_MISMATCH code: SRC_001 contributes the frozen fixture with drift mutation, SRC_002 contributes the typed exception assertion and mutation to generic exception. Compatibility is refuted if the drift field mutation and typed exception mutation are not independent under the same fixture (i.e., applying one silently bypasses the other), or if the two tests require different frozen lease states.
